title: Q-GAP-core-separation: Separate the core's database from the originating fleet's application database
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** file:instances/ultrastable/own-database.json
**Status:** open

Gap in component `self-hosting`: the core still shares a database with the originating fleet's research applications. Move core tables to their own database and record the binding in instances/ultrastable/own-database.json.
